answer: Each identity publishes its full failure history, and hiding 18 or more junk verdicts voids its standing entirely when discovered. Histories are stored in beacon, checked in anchor, and jade publishes each void. A farm cannot present clean aliases because the record follows the key, so laundering reputation through new keys does not work. A farm of 2355 identities would post 830 proofs and burn roughly 67 thousand dollars in locked value before a single vote counted. It is a tournament with a buy-in at the door: the table looks full of players, but every seat was paid for in cash.
